run.name: Davita Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (DVA)
run.summary: DaVita is a stable, cash-generative credit whose leverage is rising because buybacks exceed free cash flow. Covenant-basis leverage is 3.38x against a 5.00x maximum, and liquidity is adequate. Refinancing risk is concentrated in 2030 and 2031. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is DAVITA INC..

revenue.basis: Total revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Total debt 10,832.2 and Consolidated EBITDA 3,042 at September 30, 2026; Consolidated net debt 10,269. Excludes operating lease liabilities of 2,623.3 and puttable noncontrolling interests of 1,484.3. On operating income plus D&A plus impairment (2,880.9) total debt is 3.76x.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Consolidated EBITDA 2,960 over cash paid for interest, net of 515.5 ([10-K] page:213). Company non-GAAP EBITDA. On debt expense of 579.9 instead, cover is 5.10x.

cash.basis: Cash. Excludes restricted cash of 83.6 and short-term investments of 70.7. Revolver 80.0 drawn; revolver matures November 24, 2030 (earlier, March 2, 2030, if the 4.625% senior notes remain outstanding 91 days before their maturity). Separate bilateral facility letters of credit about 185 (184.8 in the note).

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: The credit agreement, indentures and guarantor list are not supplied, so covenant definitions and headroom are company-reported figures that cannot be verified.
CP-1 main limitation: The EBITDA is company-computed and cannot be checked to the credit agreement; cash interest is printed only for FY2025.
